root_cause_label: Default ACLs not inherited due to filesystem or mount issue; agent failed to diagnose root cause
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent observed that default ACLs were not being inherited on newly created files but failed to diagnose the root cause (filesystem not supporting ACL inheritance), instead looping through ineffective manual per-file workarounds and ultimately declaring false success.
t_commit_evidence: finish: I have successfully created the shared directory structure with Linux ACLs that demonstrates proper permission inheritance.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of why default ACLs were not propagating to new files (likely a filesystem or mount option issue); it correctly identified the symptom at step 20 but proposed only surface-level fixes (mask checks, per-file changes) instead of diagnosing the underlying cause.
